state:
**Goal `program-enumeration`: Stage 2, the class selector, is on disk, and its two checks are green.** ADR 0253 records both halves of the goal. `rule:programs/constructors` is its new rule, and stays `status: designed` until Stage 3 lands it. `implementing<T>` and `implementingWith<T, S>` take a class through `crates/nvs-types/src/program.rs:@selector_of`. Its refusal is `E0743` (`E_PROGRAM_TYPE_ARG_NOT_A_CLASS_OR_INTERFACE`). `constructors` is in `PROGRAM_SCAN_MEMBERS`.

Stage 2's tests now have the names its checks list: four in `nvs-types` and two in `nvs_hir::hierarchy`. Walked goals `core-io-file-and-1-more` and `tooling-overhaul` now name `program_implementing_refuses_an_enum_a_shape_and_a_scalar`, so `chain --check` is green again. The heading rename in `docs/reference/lang/90-attributes.md` changed the feature id to `lang:attributes/core-program-implementing-i-every-class-that-is-an-i`. Its examples, attack and bench moved there, and the two `// covers:` lines changed with them. The seven `lang:attributes` perf figures that the heading change staled have been measured again.

The two `about.md` files are incomplete, not false. Stage 4 rewrites them whole.

next.note: . One file set: `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/program.rs`, `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/registry.rs`, `crates/nvs-types/src/program.rs`, `crates/nvs-types/src/expr_table.rs`, `crates/nvs-ir/src/lower/expr.rs`, `crates/nvs-diagnostics/src/lib.rs`. **Items 1 and 2 land in one session with the conformance case.** A registry row with no `.nvst` case that calls it fails `every_core_class_has_a_conformance_floor_of_three` (`crates/nvs-stdlib/tests/conformance_coverage.rs:137`). That case needs the expansion and the lowering.

items.text: **The registry row and its cards** (`rule:programs/constructors`): add a row beside `implementingWith`'s at `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/program.rs:107`. It has no parameters and two written type arguments. Its return type is `CoreTy::Array` of a shape `{class: Text, make: CoreTy::Written("C")}`. No new `CoreTy` variant is needed, because `Written` already carries a type argument written at the call site. Exempt it from the shape guard at `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/registry.rs:4333` in the same way as `implementingWith`. Add its symbol to the abort arm at `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/program.rs:191`. Add it to the spec row at `docs/spec/01-core-library.md:1012` and the class card.

**The expansion**: put it beside `expand_with` at `crates/nvs-types/src/program.rs:115`. `is_enumeration` at `crates/nvs-types/src/program.rs:58` gains the member. Add an `ExprInfo` variant beside `ProgramInstancesWith` (`crates/nvs-types/src/expr_table.rs:1100`), and lower it beside `crates/nvs-ir/src/lower/expr.rs:3363`. Also write `tests/conformance/core/program-constructors-builds-each-class-with-the-arguments-you-pass.nvst`.

**Two refusals**: two new codes after `E0837` (`crates/nvs-diagnostics/src/lib.rs:5290`). `E0838`: `C` is not a callable type that names its parameters, or it does not return `T`. `E0839`: a listed class's constructor does not fit `C`'s parameters.
**`nvs-lsp` go-to-definition on both type arguments** (`crates/nvs-lsp/src/definition.rs:1070`), the same type-position jump that `implementing<User>()` already has.

backlog: Stage 4, the proofs: rewrite both `about.md` files, and give `constructors` its own examples, attack and bench (`rule:testing/feature-proofs`).
`docs/reference/core/Program.md` and `data/reference/core/Program.json` still describe "every class implementing an interface". Stage 4 rewrites them with the `about.md` files.
